engineering_observations: All ten retained full-frame tiles were inspected. Gold direct amodal rectangles and labels appear only on positives, with no corresponding central form or gold rectangle in the absent row.

At 0.5 cm/px a large dark elongated tapered form slants with nose left and slightly upward and tail/flukes right and slightly downward, clearly inside the gold rectangle. A smaller recognizable form and flukes appear at 1 cm/px; at coarser GSD the central form becomes slender or tiny, and the gold border dominates with little or no fine body detail.

Absent 0.5/1/2 cm/px tiles look apparently uniform blue at contact-sheet scale. At 3/4 cm/px both rows retain a pale unlabelled background animal cropped at the upper edge. All ten views were retained and reviewed; none were dropped.

The pale background animal at 3/4 cm/px has visibly different apparent extent, detail and shading between paired rows and looks longer or brighter in the absent row. The cause is unestablished; no geometry difference is inferred from RGB, and bitwise or photometric background equivalence is not claimed.

This test-split ascent snapshot retains actual GAMA motion-root depth 1.6m and the static upright proxy. Direct amodal boxes do not establish an exact visible or refracted outline; machine rendered_visibility remains unknown and biological approval remains false.
